caption: The drawing features three main objects related to a boot. On the right side, there is a detailed colored illustration of a single brown leather boot with a low stacked heel and two tan pull straps at the top. The boot has a pointed toe and visible seams, with the shading indicating the contours and roundness of the leather. To the left of the boot, there are two sketched outlines in light pencil: one shows the back view of the same boot, displaying the pull straps and heel, while the other presents the sole of the boot, detailing a stitched outline around the border and across the arch. The background is a plain, off-white color with subtle shading near the top. The composition places the colored boot prominently in the foreground with the two sketched views slightly faded and set in the background to indicate alternate perspectives.
title: Boy's Boot
